applications.name: GridMarket and Deployable Energy Unity Nuclear Battery framework
applications.power_class: approximately 1 megawatt electric (MWe) per unit; nearly 3 GW pipeline
applications.timeline: framework announced July 2026 (article dated 2026-07-08); target about 500 MW per year of deployment
applications.what_it_says: GridMarket and Deployable Energy announced a framework in July 2026 for a pipeline of nearly 3 GW of Unity Nuclear Battery microreactors. Each unit is about 1 MWe and fits in a 20-foot ISO container, with power integrated at the client's site to serve data centers, hyperscalers and industrial clients. The article does not say whether the framework is binding and says the pilot's definitive commercial terms remain to be specified.
applications.microreactor_read: A 1 MWe unit is at the small end of the 1-20 MW block range for a data-center load, but the framework names no site, load or price. It would count as a buyer deal only once it has a named first site, a binding instrument and a stated load.
